# qrcodegen (vendored)

QR Code generator library (C++) by Project Nayuki, MIT License - see the header
of each file. Used by `src/verifactu/aeatqr.cpp` to draw the Verifactu QR locally
for the direct AEAT client.

- Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator, `cpp/qrcodegen.cpp` and `cpp/qrcodegen.hpp`
- Commit: 8329a7108fc22be3e1eec0a9f9318978579e3621 (2024-09-01), unchanged
